text.description_html:
RK International CP-3713, 3 Inch New Orleans Cabinet Door Pull

A symbol of strength and power, the fleur-de-lis was made famous by the French monarch Louis VII. Today, we think of beautiful gothic decor in royal settings. RK International's Fleur-de-lis Cabinet Pull is available in 5 finishes, though we have to admit we like it in satin nickel best. There is something so stunning about the contrast of old world style and modern finish. The New Orleans Cabinet Door Pull has a 3 inch center to center. Comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-3713 New Orleans Fleur-de-lis Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-15/16"
  • Width: 9/16"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
